results.question: ¿Qué categoría creció más el último trimestre?
results.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_2026_q3, ROUND(net_sales_same_quarter_last_year, 2) AS net_sales_2025_q3, ROUND(100.0 * yoy_growth, 1) AS yoy_growth_pct FROM mart_category_quarterly WHERE year_quarter = '2026-Q3' ORDER BY yoy_growth DESC

results.question: ¿Cuál es la tasa de recompra por canal?
results.sql: SELECT acquisition_channel AS canal_de_adquisicion, COUNT(*) AS clientes_elegibles, SUM(repurchased_within_90d) AS clientes_recompra, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(repurchased_within_90d), 1) AS tasa_recompra_pct FROM dim_customer WHERE repurchased_within_90d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY acquisition_channel ORDER BY tasa_recompra_pct DESC

results.question: How much did we sell this year compared with the same period last year?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' THEN net_sales END), 2) AS net_sales_2026_ytd, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-10-31' THEN net_sales END), 2) AS net_sales_2025_same_period, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' THEN net_sales END) / SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-10-31' THEN net_sales END) - 1), 1) AS yoy_growth_pct FROM fct_orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' AND order_date NOT BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-12-31'

results.question: ¿Cuáles fueron las ventas netas por canal en 2025?
results.sql: SELECT channel_id, ROUND(SUM(net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM fct_orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY channel_id ORDER BY net_sales DESC

results.question: What is the gross margin % by category this year?
results.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(gross_margin) / SUM(net_sales), 1) AS gross_margin_pct FROM fct_order_lines WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY category ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC

results.question: What is the average order value by channel in 2026?
results.sql: SELECT channel_id, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(net_sales), 2) AS net_sales, ROUND(SUM(net_sales) / COUNT(*), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM fct_orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY channel_id ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

results.question: How many active customers do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM dim_customer WHERE is_active = 1

results.question: Which store had the highest net sales last quarter?
results.sql: SELECT s.store_name, s.city, ROUND(SUM(o.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM fct_orders o JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.channel_id = 'STORE' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY s.store_name, s.city ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the return rate by category?
results.sql:
SELECT category,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(returned_amount) / SUM(gross_sales - discount_amount), 1) AS return_rate_pct
FROM fct_order_lines
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC

results.question: Show monthly net sales for 2025.
results.sql: SELECT month_start, ROUND(SUM(net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM mart_sales_monthly WHERE month_start BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-01' GROUP BY month_start ORDER BY month_start

results.question: How many new customers did each channel acquire in 2026?
results.sql: SELECT acquisition_channel, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM dim_customer WHERE first_order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY acquisition_channel ORDER BY new_customers DESC

results.question: What share of net sales came from online channels in 2026?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.channel_type = 'Online' THEN o.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(o.net_sales), 1) AS online_share_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.channel_type = 'Online' THEN o.net_sales ELSE 0 END), 2) AS online_net_sales, ROUND(SUM(o.net_sales), 2) AS total_net_sales FROM fct_orders o JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31'

results.question: Which promotion generated the most incremental gross margin?
results.sql: SELECT promo_code, promo_name, promo_type, discount_band, start_date, end_date, ROUND(incremental_gross_margin, 2) AS incremental_gross_margin, ROUND(100.0 * net_sales_lift, 1) AS net_sales_lift_pct, ROUND(100.0 * after_vs_baseline, 1) AS after_vs_baseline_pct FROM mart_promo_performance WHERE incremental_gross_margin IS NOT NULL ORDER BY incremental_gross_margin DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: What percentage of net sales was sold on promotion each year?
results.sql: SELECT d.year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.is_promo = 1 THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END), 2) AS promo_net_sales, ROUND(SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS total_net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.is_promo = 1 THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS promo_share_pct FROM fct_order_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.date = l.order_date GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year

results.question: What is the 3-month retention of customers acquired in January 2025?
results.sql: SELECT cohort_month, months_since_first, SUM(cohort_customers) AS cohort_customers, SUM(active_customers) AS active_customers, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(active_customers) / SUM(cohort_customers), 1) AS month_3_retention_pct FROM mart_customer_cohorts WHERE cohort_month = '2025-01-01' AND months_since_first = 3 GROUP BY cohort_month, months_since_first

results.question: ¿Cuál es el ticket promedio en tiendas físicas frente a los canales en línea en 2026?
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.channel_id = 'STORE' THEN 'Tiendas físicas' ELSE 'En línea' END AS tipo_canal, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(o.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales, ROUND(SUM(o.net_sales) / COUNT(*), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM fct_orders o WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

results.question: What were the top 5 products by net sales in 2026?
results.sql: SELECT l.product_id, p.product_name, l.category, l.brand, ROUND(SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM fct_order_lines l JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY l.product_id, p.product_name, l.category, l.brand ORDER BY SUM(l.net_sales) DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: How many orders did we have in October 2026, and how does that compare with October 2025?
results.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', order_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM fct_orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-10-31' OR order_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

results.question: What is the contribution margin % by channel in 2026?
results.sql: SELECT channel_id, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(contribution_margin) / SUM(net_sales), 1) AS contribution_margin_pct FROM fct_orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY channel_id ORDER BY contribution_margin_pct DESC

results.question: Which department has the most active customers?
results.sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM dim_customer WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY department ORDER BY active_customers DESC

results.question: What were Beauty net sales by quarter in 2026?
results.sql: SELECT year_quarter, ROUND(net_sales, 2) AS net_sales FROM mart_category_quarterly WHERE category = 'Beauty' AND year = 2026 ORDER BY year_quarter

results.question: ¿Qué porcentaje de las ventas netas de Belleza en 2026 vino de productos de marca propia?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_private_label = 1 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(net_sales), 1) AS private_label_share_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_private_label = 1 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END), 2) AS private_label_net_sales, ROUND(SUM(net_sales), 2) AS beauty_net_sales FROM fct_order_lines WHERE category = 'Beauty' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31'

results.question: What are the three most common return reasons for online orders, by number of returns?
results.sql: SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS returns FROM fct_returns WHERE channel_id IN ('WEB', 'APP', 'MARKETPLACE') GROUP BY reason ORDER BY returns DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: Among customers who placed a second order, what is the average number of days between their first and second order, by acquisition channel?
results.sql: SELECT acquisition_channel, COUNT(*) AS customers_with_second_order, ROUND(AVG(days_to_second_order), 1) AS avg_days_to_second_order FROM dim_customer WHERE second_order_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY acquisition_channel ORDER BY avg_days_to_second_order DESC

results.question: Which month of 2025 had the highest net sales?
results.sql: SELECT d.year_month, ROUND(SUM(m.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM mart_sales_monthly m JOIN dim_date d ON d.date = m.month_start WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.year_month ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 1
